.. py:function:: region_grow_icas(intensity: Any, labels: np.ndarray, *, ica_ids: Sequence[int] = _DEFAULT_ICA_IDS, rg_barrier_radius: int = _ICA_RG_BARRIER_RADIUS, intensity_frac: float = _ICA_RG_INTENSITY_FRAC) -> dict[int, int]

   Grow ICA labels into empty voxels; barriers are other labels dilated by *rg_barrier_radius*.
